subject.title: fix(ai): record token usage on Responses early-abort (#100954)

question: Should this PR require a redacted live OpenAI/Azure `response.incomplete` transcript before merge, or should the exact-event regression tests and SDK contract receive a narrow proof override?
rationale: The patch has no remaining mechanical defect, but automation cannot substitute for the required real-provider run and the contributor reports having no suitable provider credentials.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Capture a redacted before/after terminal transcript or logs showing `response.incomplete` with populated usage and nonzero calculated cost.

options.title: Approve a narrow proof override
options.body: Accept the official SDK contract plus both exact-event processor regressions as sufficient for this provider-accounting fix.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted before/after terminal transcript or logs showing `response.incomplete` with populated usage and nonzero calculated cost.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and therefore the clearest available owner for the remaining proof-sufficiency decision.
